verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented rules or automation engine where a user defines event-triggered rules for Terminal. Webhooks push events to an endpoint so your own integration code can react, which is a developer building block rather than user-defined rules. Smart Disputes and automatic forwarding of offline payments are fixed built-in behaviors, not configurable rules, so they are adjacent at best.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
